prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1470; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed head-on motor vehicle collision with complaints consistent with cervical whiplash injury. The reported mechanism of injury fits well with the kind and force of the impact. Over the course of care, the patient attended 30 visits, including physical therapy, manual therapy, and home exercise instruction. Treatment followed a typical progression and tapered as symptoms improved, with reduced neck stiffness, improved range of motion, and fewer headaches reported in later visits. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury. The patient was also treated for the same region within the past two years, and that prior condition contributes to some of the current symptoms, which has been considered in the plan of care. Billing records show two similar charges on the same date of service, which are currently under review for accuracy.
